verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe documents a dedicated custom vocabulary feature for names, acronyms, product names and technical terms. It offers inline vocabularies plus reusable Vocabulary Assets with list/delete endpoints, and the active vocabulary can be updated mid-session in Live mode via session.update. The vocabulary control also appears in the synchronous transcription API schema. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that boosting improves accuracy, and documented boost weights or limits.
